source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), public fredgraph.csv endpoint

series_id.description: FRED series ID, see alpha_desk.data.universe.FRED_SERIES for labels

date.description: Observation date as published by FRED

value.description: Series value; NaN where FRED marks the observation missing ('.')

invariants: value may legitimately be NaN (holiday/not-yet-released/discontinued window) -- callers must handle this, not assume completeness
date is never later than the fetch date recorded in data/provenance/source_manifest.json
